verdict.rationale: The only admin-facing evidence is the Computer Analytics API. It shows an organization admin surface: admins can turn on Analytics API to provision API access for the organization and break usage down per member or filter it by member email. That is usage reporting, not management of members, permissions, or data policies. missing for 10: adding/removing members, role or permission assignment, data-retention/privacy policy controls, workspace-level admin console documentation, independent corroboration.
